en.headline: Woman dies after fall from Tsing Yi residential building
en.dek: Police and firefighters responded to a report at about 8:28am at Qing Ya Yuan; the woman, believed to be in her late forties, was confirmed dead at the scene.
body: A woman died after falling from a residential building in Tsing Yi early on Saturday, police said.

Officers received a report at about 8:28am that a woman had fallen from a height at Qing Ya Yuan on Nga Ying Chau Street. Firefighters and ambulance crew attended and confirmed she was dead at the scene. She was believed to be in her late forties.

Police sealed off the area and are investigating the circumstances of the fall and the woman’s identity. No suicide note was reported to have been found at the scene. The cause of death is pending further examination.
Anyone in emotional distress can contact the Samaritan Befrienders Hong Kong hotline at 2389 2222 or the Shall We Talk mental health support line at 18111.

zh.headline: 青衣青雅苑女子墮樓當場不治
zh.dek: 警方早上約8時28分接報，青雅苑有女子從高處墮下，救護員到場證實當場死亡，年齡約48至50歲。
body: 青衣青雅苑今早發生墮樓事件，一名女子當場不治。
警方表示，早上約8時28分接獲報案，指牙鷹洲街3號青雅苑有人從高處墮下，倒臥屋苑對開行人路。消防及救護員到場，經檢驗後證實女事主當場死亡。事主年齡約48至50歲。
警方封鎖現場調查，初步相信事主從單位墮下，現場沒有檢獲遺書。死因有待進一步檢驗確定。
有需要人士可致電香港撒瑪利亞防止自殺會熱線2389 2222或情緒通精神健康支援熱線18111。
